info.title: Collector telemetry
info.description:
Aggregated multi-region telemetry that the Collector service pushes to frontend clients via websocket.

## Authentication

Clients must first obtain a JWT token via `POST /api/login`. Then, upon connecting to the websocket, the client must send an authentication message within 10 seconds in the format: `{"token":"<JWT>"}`. If the token is invalid or expired the server disconnects the client; if the token is valid the server begins streaming telemetry data.

**Token expiration:** The server will also disconnect an active websocket session when the token reaches its expiration time. The client application is responsible for obtaining a new token (via `POST /api/login`) and being ready to reconnect to the websocket **before** the current token expires. Use the `expiresIn` field from the login response to schedule token renewal in advance.

post.summary: Authenticate and obtain a JWT token
post.description: Authenticates the client with username and password and returns a JWT token. The token must be sent as the first websocket message within 10 seconds of connecting: `{"token":"<JWT>"}`. If the token is invalid or expired the websocket server disconnects the client.

post.description:
***THIS IS NOT A REST REQUEST, BUT WEBSOCKET***

Aggregated telemetry that the Collector sends to frontend clients via websocket.

**Websocket authentication:** On connect, the client must send a JSON message `{"token":"<JWT from POST /api/login>"}` within 10 seconds. If the token is invalid or expired the websocket server disconnects the client. If the token is valid the server starts pushing telemetry data. The server will also disconnect the session when the token expires. The client application must obtain a new token (via `POST /api/login`) and be ready to reconnect **before** the current token expires; use the `expiresIn` field from the login response to schedule renewal.

- The Collector connects to every region in its configuration (regions.json), authenticates against each region's MAPI and subscribes to four rooms per region: AirVehicleTelemetry, GimbalsTelemetry, MissionsTelemetry, UserMessages.
- This message is emitted once per second (telemetryBroadcastInterval, configurable, default 1000 ms).
- `regionsInventory` lists every region the Collector knows about (from regions.json) with its `regionId`, name, host and health (online/offline).
- A region is omitted entirely from `regionsTele` when the newest telemetry received from it is older than a configurable staleness window of X seconds (telemetryStalenessThreshold); it still appears in `regionsInventory`. Each `regionsTele` entry identifies its region by `regionId`, which maps to an entry in `regionsInventory`.
- Each room is an array of the raw telemetry items exactly as MAPI sent them, with `timestampLastChanged` (epoch-ms of that item's last change) merged onto each item. AirVehicleTelemetry items additionally carry `videoUrls`.

GimbalTelemetryItem.title: GimbalTelemetryItem
GimbalTelemetryItem.description: One entry of a region's GimbalsTelemetry array: all fields of the MAPI gimbal telemetry (as sent by MAPI), with the epoch-ms timestamp of the last change merged in.

timestampLastChanged.description: Epoch-ms timestamp stamped by the Collector — the system that aggregates the rooms — recording when this item was last updated in the aggregated telemetry.

MAPI_ACTION_ZOOM.title: MAPI_ACTION_ZOOM
MAPI_ACTION_ZOOM.description: The camera zoom before or after the action. If the value is not specified, the system does not change the zoom.

type.description:
`type` – String (required): `scan` sweeps the gimbal through a defined arc when drone will be paused on the waypoint; `gimbalMove` points the gimbal at a specific yaw or target when drone will be paused on the waypoint; `gimbalMoveFlying` points the gimbal at a specific yaw or target after flight resume (it means that the requested gimbal parameters will be during the flight).
The action order: 1 - `scan`; 2 - `gimbalMove`; 3 - `gimbalMoveFlying`.
The point can contain all actions or part of actions or be a bay of actions (empty array)

parameters.description: must follow the schema for the chosen type—use the scan parameter set when type = `scan`, and the gimbalMove parameter set when type = `gimbalMove` or type = `gimbalMoveFlying`

yaw.description: Desired gimbal yaw angle (degrees): measured clockwise from true north when relType is `North`, or clockwise from the upcoming leg’s heading when relType is `FlightLeg`.

viewDistance.description: Horizontal range to the view target, in meters; combined with the drone’s current altitude and the target’s ground elevation to compute the required gimbal pitch.

viewDuration_ms.description:
timeout for first `gimbalMove` action (enter `gimbalMove`). The gimbal will be pointed at the point for at least the specified time (`duration_ms`)
If this field is not defined, the value will be 0

relType.description: Reference frame for the yaw angle. Currently only `Body` (relative to the drone's body heading) is supported for gimbalMove actions.

isAiAction.description: When `true`, the captured frame is sent to the AI module specified by `aiModule` for analysis.

aiModule.description: AI module to use for analysis: `Traffic` for vehicle counting/occupancy, `License Plate` for plate recognition, or `Prompt Based` for custom prompt-driven detection.

trafficType.description: Sub-mode for the `Traffic` AI module: `Traffic Count` counts vehicles, `Occupancy` measures area occupancy.

selectedCube.description: References a pre-configured detection cube for AI analysis.

prompt.description: Free-text prompt sent to the `Prompt Based` AI module describing what to detect or analyze.

detectionType.description: Detection strategy for the `Prompt Based` AI module: `detect` finds objects, `query` answers questions about the scene, `point` identifies a specific location.

alertAction.description: When `true`, triggers an alert if the AI module detects a match.

watchObjects.description: List of object labels the AI module should watch for (e.g. `["person", "vehicle"]`).

MAPI_PATROL_MISSION.title: MAPI_PATROL_MISSION
MAPI_PATROL_MISSION.description: is a single-request endpoint for programming an autonomous drone patrol route, including waypoint coordinates, altitude limits, speeds, and per-point camera view or scan actions.

name.description: A descriptive title for the patrol mission.

isAGL.description:
True  → all altitude values are AGL and must fall within altitudeRange.min / altitudeRange.max.
False → altitudes are instead derived from staticPartAltType, dynamicPartAltType, and any per-point values in patrolPoints

ASL_Max.description: Highest permitted altitude (Above-Sea-Level) for the mission, in meters; if any waypoint or segment exceeds this value, the mission fails validation and cannot be uploaded to the drone.

maxSlopeDegree.description: Maximum allowed climb or descent angle between consecutive route points, in degrees; if any segment exceeds this value the mission is rejected. If the field is omitted, the system applies its configured default.

isDynamicNFZ.description: Adds a dynamic no-fly-zone “sleeve” along the route for operational-altitude flights (AGL and manual-altitude missions include the dynamic NFZ automatically).

isStopMission.description: Stops the mission automatically when the drone transitions to **Observing** status.

isRHSameRoute.description: Causes the Return-Home mission to follow the exact route of the first mission uploaded after takeoff.

dynamicPartAltType.description:
Controls the altitude mode for the dynamic legs (take-off → route and route → home) **only when `isAGL` is `false`**:

* **"auto"** (default) — fly those legs at the dron’s operational altitude.
* **"forceByRoute\_Alt"** — fly to the route (and return home) using the first patrol point’s altitude settings

staticPartAltType.description: Sets the altitude mode for the patrol route: "operationalAlt" (default) flies the entire route at the drone's operational altitude, while "manualAlt" lets each patrol point define its own altitude.

patrolPoints.description: Ordered list of waypoint objects that define the patrol route and actions on each point

startScanYaw.description: Initial yaw angle for the scan sweep, in degrees—measured clockwise from the reference set by `relType` (true north if `North`, the current leg’s heading if `FlightLeg`). The gimbal begins rotating from this angle toward `finishScanYaw`.

finishScanYaw.description: Final yaw angle for the scan sweep, in degrees—measured clockwise from the same `relType` reference; the gimbal rotates from `startScanYaw` to this angle (respecting the specified sweep `direction`).

startDistance.description: Initial horizontal distance from the drone to the scan target, in meters; defines the radius at which the sweep begins.

finishDistance.description: Final horizontal distance to the scan target, in meters; the sweep ends at this radius (interpolated from `startDistance`).

duration_ms.description: The scan duration in milliseconds; must be 0 or a positive value.

direction.description: Rotation direction for the scan sweep—choose **`clockwise`** or **`counterClockwise`**.

relType.description: Reference frame for yaw angles: `North` (true north), `Body` (drone body heading), or `FlightLeg` (direction of the current leg).

isAiAction.description: When `true`, the captured frame is sent to the AI module specified by `aiModule` for analysis.

aiModule.description: AI module to use for analysis: `Traffic` for vehicle counting/occupancy, `License Plate` for plate recognition, or `Prompt Based` for custom prompt-driven detection.

trafficType.description: Sub-mode for the `Traffic` AI module: `Traffic Count` counts vehicles, `Occupancy` measures area occupancy.

selectedCube.description: References a pre-configured detection cube for AI analysis.

prompt.description: Free-text prompt sent to the `Prompt Based` AI module describing what to detect or analyze.

detectionType.description: Detection strategy for the `Prompt Based` AI module: `detect` finds objects, `query` answers questions about the scene, `point` identifies a specific location.

alertAction.description: When `true`, triggers an alert if the AI module detects a match.

watchObjects.description: List of object labels the AI module should watch for (e.g. `["person", "vehicle"]`).

MAPI_POINT_PATROL.description: Ordered list of waypoint objects that define the patrol route

velocity.description: Cruise speed for the next leg, in meters per second.

altType.description: Altitude reference for this waypoint when `staticPartAltType` is `manualAlt`: `AGL` (above ground level), `ASL` (above sea level), or `ATP` (above take-off point).

altitude.description: Altitude for this waypoint, in meters, interpreted by `altType`; applies only when `staticPartAltType` is `manualAlt`. If omitted, the drone’s operational altitude is used.

headingType.description: Determines how the aircraft’s heading is handled on the next leg: **`Auto`** (default) keeps the nose aligned with the flight path, **`Free`** follows the mission-level heading but allows mid-flight adjustment, and **`Fixed`** locks the heading to the mission’s preset angle.

headingRelativeLeg.description: Heading offset in degrees relative to the direction of the current leg (0 = facing forward, 180 = backward); respected when headingType is Free or Fixed, ignored when headingType is Auto.

actions.description: Gimbal actions to run at this waypoint. The actions array can contain only one action of each type (`scan`, `gimbalMove`, `gimbalMoveFlying`) , or be an empty array.

totalLength.description: Total length of route from home to end of mission in meters

MissionTelemetryItem.title: MissionTelemetryItem
MissionTelemetryItem.description: One entry of a region's MissionsTelemetry array: all fields of the MAPI mission telemetry (as sent by MAPI), with the epoch-ms timestamp of the last change merged in.

timestampLastChanged.description: Epoch-ms timestamp stamped by the Collector — the system that aggregates the rooms — recording when this item was last updated in the aggregated telemetry.

timestampMissionStarted.description: Epoch-ms timestamp captured by the Collector when this `missionId` first reached status `Started`. It is fixed at that first start and remains unchanged for the lifetime of the `missionId` (it does not move on later status changes); it is reset only when a new `missionId` appears.

RegionInventoryItem.title: RegionInventoryItem
RegionInventoryItem.description: One region in the Collector's inventory: its identity and current reachability.

health.description: Current reachability of the region as seen by the Collector.

timestampLastChanged.description: Epoch-ms timestamp stamped by the Collector recording when this region's inventory entry (its identity or health) was last updated.

RegionTelemetry.title: RegionTelemetry
RegionTelemetry.description: Aggregated telemetry for a single region, identified by `regionId` (which matches an entry in the top-level `regionsInventory`). Each MAPI room (AirVehicleTelemetry, GimbalsTelemetry, MissionsTelemetry, UserMessages) is an array of the raw telemetry items MAPI sent, with `timestampLastChanged` (epoch-ms of that item's last change) merged onto each item; AirVehicleTelemetry items additionally carry `videoUrls`.

regionId.description: Stable UUID identifying this region. Matches the `regionId` of an entry in the top-level `regionsInventory` array.

AirVehicleTelemetry.description: Air vehicles in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI airVehicle telemetry plus videoUrls and timestampLastChanged. An empty array means no air-vehicle data has been received from this region since the Collector started (or restarted).

GimbalsTelemetry.description: Gimbals in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI gimbal telemetry plus timestampLastChanged. An empty array means no gimbal data has been received from this region since the Collector started (or restarted).

MissionsTelemetry.description: Missions in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI mission telemetry plus timestampLastChanged. An empty array means no mission data has been received from this region since the Collector started (or restarted).

UserMessages.description: User messages in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI user message plus timestampLastChanged. An empty array means no user messages have been received from this region since the Collector started (or restarted).

RegionsTelemetryOut.title: RegionsTelemetryOut
RegionsTelemetryOut.description: Top-level websocket message broadcast by the Collector once per second. `regionsInventory` lists every region the Collector knows about (with health); `regionsTele` holds one entry per region that is currently producing fresh telemetry. Regions whose newest telemetry is older than the configurable staleness window (telemetryStalenessThreshold) are omitted from `regionsTele` but remain in `regionsInventory`.

regionsInventory.description: Inventory of every region known to the Collector (from regions.json), each with its identity (regionId, regionName, regionHost) and current health (online/offline). A region present here but absent from `regionsTele` is known but not currently producing fresh telemetry.

regionsTele.description: One entry per region currently producing fresh telemetry. Each entry references its region via `regionId` (see `regionsInventory`).

SHIP_MISSION.v1.title: SHIP_MISSION
SHIP_MISSION.v1.description:
The shipment mission data is actually a point that the air vehicle can take off from or ship to.
The shipment flight altitude will be taken fron the air vehicleoperational flight altitude.
When the air vehicle will pass the route PNR the altitude will set according to the shiping point alt so it is important to set the exact altitude of both the take off shipment point and the destination shipment point

dynamicPartAltType.description: If forceByRoute exists - If set to forceByRoute_Alt, the dynamic routes will have the alts of the first and the last points of the static route

staticPartAltType.description: If forceByRoute exists - If isAGL is false, staticPartAltType needs to be set to "manualAlt" in order to allow points in static route to be AGL/ASL

distanceFromTrackPoint.description:
The minimum distance from the track point that the drone will be fly to using the mission route.
If it is impossible to fly to the requested point with the requested distance, the system can increase the distance.
If that field is not set - FlightOps will use the config default.

trackPointAGL.description:
If the point is above the ground DTM data then the parameter will be added to the point altitude.
Default is 0.

setAngleToTarget.description:
If true - the mission route calculation will use the angleToTrackPoint parameter.
If false - default configuration will be used and the drone will fly to the shortest route.

isAGLFlight.description:
If AGL flight defined then the mission route will calculated according to the missionAGL field.
In case of false - the flight will be according to the drone operational altitude.

missionAGL.description:
The AGL flight requested altitude.
The field is requiered if siAGLFlight is set to true.

isSave.description: if this field is "true" - the task will be saved in the DB

UserMessageItem.title: UserMessageItem
UserMessageItem.description: One entry of a region's UserMessages array: all fields of the MAPI user message (as sent by MAPI), with the epoch-ms timestamp of the last change merged in.

timestampLastChanged.description: Epoch-ms timestamp stamped by the Collector — the system that aggregates the rooms — recording when this item was last updated in the aggregated telemetry.

VideoUrl.title: VideoUrl
VideoUrl.description: A video stream URL for a drone. Derived from the region's MAPI getConfiguration sensors: the sensor `videoURL` (an https URL such as https://host:8889/path/a/b) is converted to an rtsp URL by these rules: (1) swap the scheme http(s):// -> rtsp://, (2) replace port 8889 with 8554, (3) strip any trailing slash. Example: https://host:8889/path/a/b/ -> rtsp://host:8554/path/a/b.

videoUrl.description: RTSP stream URL. Scheme rtsp://, port 8554, trailing slash removed; path preserved from the source MAPI sensor videoURL.

missionId.description: ID of task the Air vehicle is assigned to. Empty if unassigned

routeStatus.description: Air vehicle status in route. Empty if Air vehicle is unassigned

energyConsumption.description: Energy Consumption in percent per second

location.description: The drone location and flight altitude ASL

heading.description: Heading relative to north in degrees

operationalAlt.description: Altitude the Air vehicle operates in, measured in meters

velocity.description: Air vehicle velocity in meter per second

minAltitude.description: The minimum altitude for Air vehicle to fly in meters

maxAltitude.description: The maximum altitude for Air vehicle to fly in meters

availableSlots.description: Altitude ranges that are available for Air vehicle to select height from

energyForReturnHome.description: Energy percent that when reached, the Air vehicle should return home

timeToBeReplaced.description: Time left until drone should be replaced, measured in seconds

technicalStatus.description: Connection status to services and components

controlledBy.description: The system the drone is controlled by

externalLocationData.description: If external location is used, provides location and statuses of external location sensor

rawData.description: Strings of information about internal statuses/errors of EL sensor

lockedForRH.description: Is return home command locked by UAV's internal state (winch is down for example). RH can be forced by adding isIgnoreLockedForRH param to RH command

onRhRequest.description: If UAV received RH request. UAV will try to RH if not lockedForRH or cannot compute route

isNeedToRHOnEnergy.description: If drone needs to RH on energy

lockedForRHReasons.description: Lists the reasons lockedForRH value is true

onboardMessages.description:
The controller level data. 
The array will include TBD config last messages queue . 
The messages won't always be up to date and can show historical messages (for example if the drone is off).
The array could be empty if the drone is not connected or the drone controller data is not supported.

controllerTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the drone controlle. Notice that the timestamp can be not sync with the air vehicle telemetry.

sensorVector.description: The gimbal vector line as drawn on FlightOps map

requestedAzimuth.description: Requested azimuth of drone heading in FlyTo

gimbalMode.description: The gimbal mode. NotActive if unknown, Auto if follows target, manual if controlled by user

routeIndexData.description: When drone is in mission, shows the current waypoint index the drone reached

headingMode.description: "fixed" - can not possible to change the Drone Heading. "free" - can to change the Dron Heading

zoomValue.description: camera zoom value in percent from 0 to 100

wayPoints.description: Current waypoints data for the air vehicle's active route

lengthOfPointsLeft.description: Number of remaining waypoints in the route

isSettedVelocity.description: Whether the velocity was successfully set for the current point

status.description: Waypoints action status: 0 = start, 1 = stop, 2 = pause, 3 = resume, -1 = undefined

points.description: Array of waypoint objects defining the route

velocity.description: Target velocity at this waypoint in m/s

yaw.description: Target yaw angle; the drone begins setting this heading when departing from this point

distance2nextPoint.description: Distance to next waypoint in meters

changeRouteStatus.description: Status of an in-progress route change operation

isDelay.description: Whether there is a significant delay with onboard communication

timeDiffWithOnboard.description: Time difference with onboard clock in milliseconds

takeoffASLHeight.description: Takeoff point altitude above sea level in meters

perimeterId.description: ID of the perimeter this air vehicle belongs to

gimbalCorrectionPosible.description: Indicates whether gimbal correction is currently possible. Relevant only when the drone is flying a Patrol task.

isPossible.description: Whether gimbal correction can be applied

pointIndex.description: Index of the patrol point in the task's polyline (not the flight route index) where the drone currently is

actionIndex.description: Index of the action within the patrol point identified by pointIndex

constraints.description: Drone operational constraints and capability flags

isDisableStopMissionInTakeoff.description: Whether stopping mission during takeoff is disabled

isDisableELP.description: Whether ELP (Emergency Landing Point) is disabled

isDisableLandNow.description: Whether Land Now command is disabled

isHoldSupport.description: Whether hold/hover in place is supported

gimbalYawAsDjiCommand.description: Whether gimbal yaw is sent as DJI command format

the heading of the air vehicle tail at the last route point

headingType.description:
